cohortBindingDigestOrdering: Members sorted by provider symbol using code-unit comparison, then joined as symbol|instrumentIdentityId|identityManifestId lines with a trailing LF. Code-unit ordering is required because ICU collation disagrees on punctuated symbols such as BF.B and BRK-B.
exclusionReason: INSTRUMENT_KIND_UNRESOLVED instruments carry no positive structured quoteType evidence and are excluded from both RAW acquisition and observation admission.
providerSymbolBindingProof: Each cohort member resolves through InstrumentAliasBindingCore/1 with providerId yahoo-finance2 and bindingStatus CONFIRMED, so provider symbol binding is proven for RAW acquisition independently of historical observation admissibility.
